data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for automated bug reporting and session tracking.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to submit bug reports automatically with useful data by shaking their device or calling the API. Includes session tracking and user management features.
use_when: You want to automatically collect bug reports and user data from your app.
You need in-app user feedback or chat capabilities for bug fixing.
avoid_when: You need crash reporting functionality, which is listed as not available.
You want a fully open-source, self-hosted bug reporting tool without third-party services.
strengths: Provides quick integration for automated bug reports.
Supports custom forms, tags, and session tracking.
weaknesses: Crash reporting is currently not available.
Requires platform-specific API keys and relies on the Shake backend.
data.setup_notes: Requires obtaining an API key for Android and iOS, adding the dependency to pubspec.yaml, and calling Shake.start() in main.dart.
